overview_description.description: Spare is an electronic payments company that helps campuses become safer and cash-free. With Spare installed in schools, parents can be confident that their child will always be able to purchase whatever they require without carrying cash; no more forgetting or losing their allowance, and no more bullying. Due to popular demand, it now includes a safety layer that notifies parents when their child arrives or departs from school, keeping them informed of their child's safety and location.
